name: Stamos

nadir.desc: The property consists of a large multi-section residence with a gray multi-gable roof|A paved driveway leads from the street to a parking area in front of the house|Dense mature pine trees surround the structure on all sides|A tennis court is located in a clearing on one side of the lot|Open dry ground is mixed with the tree cover.

alpha.desc: The front of the residence shows a paved driveway curving from the street up to the house|Dense mature pine trees frame both sides of the approach|Portions of the gray roof and front elevation are visible through the trees|Vehicles are parked near the front of the structure.

bravo.desc: The left side of the residence is heavily screened by dense mature pine trees|Portions of the roof and structure are visible through the canopy|A tennis court appears in a clearing near this side of the property|Open ground is limited by the tree cover.

charlie.desc: The rear of the residence is surrounded by dense mature pine trees|Portions of the house and a lower outdoor area are visible through the vegetation|A tennis court is located in a clearing nearby|Tree coverage limits clear views of the full rear elevation.

delta.desc: The right side of the residence is dominated by dense mature pine trees|The paved driveway and front parking area are partially visible|The house structure is largely screened by the surrounding vegetation.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a paved driveway that leads from the street to a parking area in front of the residence. Dense mature pine trees surround the house on all sides and limit visibility and sightlines. Open space near the driveway and the tennis court clearing provides some room for emergency vehicle staging. The property is located in a residential area with direct road frontage.
clarifications: Are there any gates or barriers controlling access to the property? Is vehicle or pedestrian access available to the rear of the house? Are there any additional pathways through the trees not visible from the available imagery? How dense is the tree coverage for emergency vehicle and personnel movement around the full perimeter of the residence?
